review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and technical self-review); no native-speaker signoff
review: N673 napari-like True 3D view in Make Masks: layer list, renderings, axes/grid toggle, Pick/Paint/Erase on the slice plane and full-resolution rendering. Option names inside the rendering tooltip match the translated option names.

records.key: Drag to turn the view, Shift+drag to move it, wheel to zoom. The image is drawn from a downsampled copy; mask edits and voxel counts use the full image.
records.source: Drag to turn the view, Shift+drag to move it, wheel to zoom. The image is drawn from a downsampled copy; mask edits and voxel counts use the full image.
records.translation: Dra för att vrida vyn, Skift+dra för att flytta den, hjulet zoomar. Bilden ritas från en nedsamplad kopia; maskredigeringar och voxelantal använder hela bilden.

records.key: Click an object in the 3D view to choose it.
records.source: Click an object in the 3D view to choose it.
records.translation: Klicka på ett objekt i 3D-vyn för att välja det.

records.key: Paint the chosen object on the slice plane, where the blue frame shows it.
records.source: Paint the chosen object on the slice plane, where the blue frame shows it.
records.translation: Måla det valda objektet på snittplanet, där den blå ramen visar det.

records.key: Erase every object on the slice plane under the brush.
records.source: Erase every object on the slice plane under the brush.
records.translation: Radera alla objekt på snittplanet under penseln.

records.key: Draw the axes, ticks and grid around the volume. They zoom and move with the data.
records.source: Draw the axes, ticks and grid around the volume. They zoom and move with the data.
records.translation: Rita axlar, skalstreck och rutnät runt volymen. De zoomar och flyttas med data.

records.key: Draw this view from every voxel. Turning or zooming draws from the downsampled copy again.
records.source: Draw this view from every voxel. Turning or zooming draws from the downsampled copy again.
records.translation: Rita den här vyn från varje voxel. Att vrida eller zooma ritar från den nedsamplade kopian igen.
Visa eller dölj det här lagret.

records.key: The colour this channel is drawn in.
records.source: The colour this channel is drawn in.
records.translation: Färgen som den här kanalen ritas i.

records.key: How opaque this layer is drawn.
records.source: How opaque this layer is drawn.
records.translation: Hur ogenomskinligt det här lagret ritas.

records.key: Intensities at or below this are drawn black.
records.source: Intensities at or below this are drawn black.
records.translation: Intensiteter på eller under detta värde ritas svarta.

records.key: Intensities at or above this are drawn at full colour.
records.source: Intensities at or above this are drawn at full colour.
records.translation: Intensiteter på eller över detta värde ritas i full färg.

records.key: MIP draws the brightest voxel along each line of sight; Attenuated MIP dims what lies behind bright voxels; Translucent draws the volume as a glowing fog. Masks are drawn as shaded surfaces or as coloured glass.
records.source: MIP draws the brightest voxel along each line of sight; Attenuated MIP dims what lies behind bright voxels; Translucent draws the volume as a glowing fog. Masks are drawn as shaded surfaces or as coloured glass.
records.translation: MIP ritar den ljusaste voxeln längs varje siktlinje; Dämpad MIP dämpar det som ligger bakom ljusa voxlar; Genomskinlig ritar volymen som en lysande dimma. Masker ritas som skuggade ytor eller som färgat glas.

records.key: Shown at 1/{n} resolution; Render at full resolution shows every voxel.
records.source: Shown at 1/{n} resolution; Render at full resolution shows every voxel.
records.translation: Visas i 1/{n} upplösning; Rendera i full upplösning visar varje voxel.

records.key: Turn the view so the slice plane faces you to paint on it.
records.source: Turn the view so the slice plane faces you to paint on it.
records.translation: Vrid vyn så att snittplanet är vänt mot dig för att måla på det.
